title: Postgres access layer & migrations (stratum schema)

user_story.i_want: a shared Postgres pool and versioned migrations for Stratum's own tables
user_story.so_that: every service uses the same schema-evolution process

description: stratum-db builds a PgPool from DatabaseSettings. Migrations live in `migrations/` at the repo root and run via sqlx. The first migration creates schema `stratum` with `ingest_files` (the ledger), `checkpoints` and `job_runs` (see docs/architecture.md). Repositories: IngestFileRepo (`insert_discovered` returning only newly inserted rows, `set_status`), CheckpointRepo (get/set), JobRunRepo (start/finish). Decide between a Postgres enum and text + CHECK for the status column, and record it in an ADR.

acceptance_criteria.then: all tables exist; running again is a no-op

acceptance_criteria.given: a (bucket, key) already in the ledger
acceptance_criteria.then: nothing is inserted and it is not returned (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING ... RETURNING)
it succeeds with SQLX_OFFLINE=true and the committed .sqlx metadata

rust_concepts: Sharing a pool (PgPool is cheap to clone)
